name: Bio
doc: Bio (spell): one emitter per action - the stage wobbling, acid pools morphing around the target, bubbles and splashes, a boiling acid blob with its palette cycling that bursts into droplets and a flash, mists, the target redrawn wobbling; the damage once the blob burst. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag022_bio.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: its sound, the acid pools, the bubbles, the boiling blob, the mists, the target overlay at their ticks

parts.title: Blob
parts.doc: The boiling acid blob on the target, bursting into droplets and a flash
